Collector receivers: OTLP/HTTP on `0.0.0.0:4318` and OTLP/gRPC on `0.0.0.0:4317`.
Collector batch processor flushes every 5 s.
Collector promotes resource attributes `task` and `backend` to Loki stream labels.
Collector forwards the log body raw (`loki.format` = `raw`) so the logfmt line reaches Loki unchanged.
Collector promotes log attributes `event` and `model` to Loki stream labels; `role` is not promoted on the OTLP path.
Collector Loki exporter pushes to `http://loki:3100/loki/api/v1/push` with the default `job` label enabled and `exporter` label disabled.
Collector exposes metrics for scraping on `0.0.0.0:8889` with resource attributes converted to metric labels.
The collector defines only `logs` and `metrics` pipelines; there is no `traces` pipeline, so the shippers' `/v1/traces` posts are not accepted by the bundled stack.
Bundled Prometheus scrapes job `otel-collector` at `otel-collector:8889` every 15 s.
Dashboards are provisioned from `/var/lib/grafana/dashboards` into folder `Specstride`.
Grafana datasource `Loki` has uid `loki` (default datasource, URL `http://loki:3100`, max 2000 lines); the dashboard references this uid.
Grafana datasource `Prometheus` has uid `prometheus` (URL `http://prometheus:9090`, not default).

The bash emitter never de-duplicates keys: `run_start` carries `feature` twice (the ambient `SPECSTRIDE_FEATURE` field and the explicit pair), so the JSON line has a duplicate key (observed in the R18 probe run)

`proposer_start` carries `backend` twice with DIFFERENT values: the ambient label `prop:<proposer>/crit:<critic>` and the explicit proposer backend; a last-key-wins JSON parser reads the proposer backend (observed in the R18 probe run)

`ts` is the string `<epoch>.<nanoseconds>` from `date +%s.%N`, falling back to whole seconds where the platform `date` rejects `%N`; `time` is `date -Is`, falling back to the platform's default `date` text: event timestamps are platform-dependent in format
The bash emitter consumes key/value pairs while more than one argument remains, so a trailing key without a value is silently dropped
`bootstrap_contract.py` creates a draft launch contract from Spec Kit artifacts; exit 0 on success

`bootstrap_contract.py --feature PATH` repeatable; relative paths resolve against the repo root; a file path is replaced by its parent directory; a non-directory raises `feature path is not a directory`
`bootstrap_contract.py --output PATH|-` default `-` (stdout); a path is written atomically (mkstemp + fsync + os.replace), parent dirs created
`bootstrap_contract.py --applied-file PATH`; default `<state dir>/features/<slug>/learning/applied.json` only when exactly one feature is in scope
`bootstrap_contract.py --learning-mode off|suggest|apply` default `off`
`bootstrap_contract.py --repo DIR` (required); a non-directory is an argparse error (exit 2, `repository is not a directory: <root>`)
`bootstrap_contract.py` exits 2 (argparse `parser.error`) on any `OSError`/`ValueError` during derivation
Bootstrap output is JSON with `indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False` and a trailing newline
Phase grammar in tasks.md: `^##\s+Phase\s+(\d+)\s*:\s*(.+?)\s*$` case-insensitive
Task grammar in tasks.md: `^-\s*\[([ xX])\]\s+(T\d+[A-Za-z]?)\s+(?:\[P\]\s+)?(?:\[([^\]]+)\]\s+)?(.*)$`; task record fields `id phase line checked parallel_marker story text source`
Checkbox-insensitive semantic hash: regex `(?m)^(\s*-\s*\[)[ xX](\]\s+T\d+[A-Za-z]?\b)` replaces the mark by a space before SHA-256 of the text
`repository` records `root`, git `revision` (`git rev-parse HEAD`, 20 s timeout) and `dirty` (`git status --porcelain`, 30 s timeout); both `null` when git fails

Feature auto-resolution without `--feature`: the repo root itself when it holds `tasks.md` or `spec.md`; else exactly one `specs/*` directory holding `tasks.md` or `spec.md`; otherwise error `feature is ambiguous; pass --feature for each in-scope feature (candidates: ...)`

Source inventory: `.specify/memory/constitution.md` (kind `constitution`), per feature the seven artifacts `spec.md plan.md tasks.md research.md data-model.md quickstart.md verification-commands.json` (kind = basename without extension) and every non-symlink file under `contracts/` (kind `contract`) and `checklists/` (kind `checklist`); sorted by absolute path
Shell candidates: fenced blocks (```` ``` ````, `bash`, `sh`, `shell`, `console`) in `plan.md` and `quickstart.md` only, recorded with `path start_line end_line text classification=candidate-only`

Prerequisite candidates: in every `.md` source, backticked tokens containing `/` or `.` (not starting with `-`, no spaces) on a line carrying `PRE-<n>` or under a heading matching `prerequisite`; resolved against the repository root; fields `id source{path,line,anchor} path resolved present`
Verification document record for `verification-commands.json`: `path valid_json` plus `error` or `feature phase_map commands`
Obligation id is `OBL-` + first 12 hex (upper-cased) of SHA-256 over `<source>:<line>:<task id>:<text>`
Each source record carries `path` (repo-relative, else absolute), `kind`, `sha256`, `lines` (0 when not UTF-8) and for kind `tasks` a `semantic_sha256`
Contract id is the lower-cased feature directory names joined by `-and-`, non `[a-z0-9]` runs collapsed to `-`, or `pipeline` when empty

One coverage entry per task: `kind=implementation`, `timing=specstride-phase:<n>` or `unclassified`, `producer=unclassified`, `disposition=unresolved`, empty `stage_ids`/`verification_ids`/`evidence`, `rationale` = task text
Draft contract constants: `schema_version` `1.0`, `status` `draft`, `generated_by` `{tool: mixture-of-loops/bootstrap_contract.py, version: 1.0}`, `authorized_roots` `[repo root]`, `stages` `[]`

Bootstrap writes five configuration keys no runtime code reads: `color=auto`, `specstride_live=true`, `agent_stream=true`, `live_detail=full`, `telemetry.loki.enabled=false`, `telemetry.otel.enabled=false`

The single bootstrap finding: id `semantic-derivation-required`, severity `blocker`, status `open`, with fixed message and resolution text; its source is the first coverage entry's source, else the first source line 1 anchor `artifact-set`
Learning binding: `decisions_through` is the `run_id` of the LAST JSON line in applied.json that has a string `run_id`; block omitted when the file is absent or no line has a run id
`MOL_VIA`: unless equal to `shell`, the three skill scripts print a `note: <script> ran without MOL_VIA=shell set; ...` reminder on stderr; exit code and stdout unchanged
`WIGGUM_LEARNING` may not be declared in an action env (`cannot sit beside SPECSTRIDE_LEARNING`)
`SPECSTRIDE_LEARNING_THROUGH` in an action env must be a literal non-empty run id
`SPECSTRIDE_LEARNING` in an action env must be a literal in `off|suggest|apply`, never `from_env`

`RETRYABLE_STOP_REASONS` is exactly `wall_budget` and `proposer_consecutive_errors`: the only Specstride `run_stop.reason` strings a `specstride` stage may list in `recovery.reason.allowed` (string match against Specstride's events)
Artifact directory `.mixture-of-loops/` beside the launcher; a launcher already inside a directory of that name uses that directory itself
Reminder text `note: <script> ran without MOL_VIA=shell set; run it as a shell command line prefixed MOL_VIA=shell (SKILL.md steps 3 and 8), in %%bash or a ! line ...` (stderr)
Stage kinds accepted: `setup decision command specstride smoke`
Check types accepted: `file_exists dir_exists env_set command_available command_success json_field_equals`
Coverage dispositions accepted: `mapped optional out-of-scope unresolved unsupported`
Sensitive env names (`TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|API_KEY|PRIVATE_KEY` as a `_`-delimited segment, case-insensitive) may not carry literal values: `... must use from_env; literal secrets are forbidden`
Validation error `cannot read contract: <exc>` / `contract must be a JSON object` from `load_contract`
Strict validation rejects an inventoried prerequisite that is present but checked by no stage precondition path and explained by no resolved/accepted finding at its source line

Strict validation of `--verification-commands <file>` in a stage action: the file must exist non-empty (resolved from the stage cwd) and match Specstride's shape (object with non-empty `commands`; each `id` unique non-empty, `phase` and `timeoutSec` positive ints, `executable` non-empty, `args` list of strings, `cwd` absolute existing dir)

Action validation: `argv must be a nonempty string array`, no newline or NUL in argv, and a shell (`sh bash zsh dash`) followed by `-c` or `-lc` is refused (`cannot execute a shell command string`); `timeout_seconds` positive (default 3600)
Action env values are a literal string or `{from_env: NAME, required: bool}`
`file_exists` on an existing directory or on `<state dir>/features/<slug>` is refused (`use dir_exists, or name a file inside it`)

Check validation: `file_exists`/`dir_exists`/`json_field_equals` need `path` inside authorized roots; `env_set`/`command_available` need `name`; `json_field_equals` needs `field` and `value`; `timing` must be `preflight` or `stage` (default `stage`)
A postcondition with `timing: preflight` is refused (`timing preflight applies to preconditions only`)
Stale check: a source whose SHA-256 changed is stale unless kind `tasks` and the checkbox-normalized hash still equals `semantic_sha256`; unreadable source reported `sources[i] cannot be read`
Declared stage seconds = `max_attempts` x action `timeout_seconds` (default 3600) + sum of `backoff_seconds`
Relaunch budget default: 2 relaunches; ceiling (relaunches+1) x declared pipeline seconds; `source` is `declared` or `default`
Effective learned values = last `apply`/`revert` (or action-less) entry per (knob, phase, shape); only entries still `apply` are kept as `{knob: {phase: value}}`

Learning prefix = bytes of applied.json up to and including the first line whose `run_id` equals `decisions_through`; its SHA-256 must equal `decisions_sha256`, else `LearningDecisionsChanged` (a stale-source subclass, exit 23)

`configuration.learning` must have exactly the keys `mode decisions_through decisions_sha256 effective source_path`; `source_path` relative; every `specstride` stage `action.env`/`resume.env` must declare the same `SPECSTRIDE_LEARNING` and `SPECSTRIDE_LEARNING_THROUGH`
Without a `configuration.learning` block a stage may not declare `SPECSTRIDE_LEARNING_THROUGH` nor `SPECSTRIDE_LEARNING=apply`
`configuration.auto` accepts only keys `max_relaunches` (int 0..5) and `wall_clock_seconds` (>0 and at most (relaunches+1) x declared pipeline seconds)
Specstride state directory name under a cwd is `.specstride` unless only the legacy `.wiggum` exists

Legacy normalization (in memory, one warning per site): stage kind `wiggum` -> `specstride`; argv[0] / `command_available` name `wiggum` -> `specstride`; `WIGGUM_*` env keys -> `SPECSTRIDE_*`; `configuration.wiggum_live` -> `specstride_live`; coverage timing `wiggum-phase:N` -> `specstride-phase:N`
Strict validation: `schema_version must be '1.0'`
Strict validation: `id must be kebab-case` (`^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`); same rule for stage ids
Validation: `status must be draft or validated`; when not `allow_draft`: `contract status must be validated`
Strict validation requires bootstrap provenance (`generated_by.tool` string and `inventory` object): `the contract was not started by bootstrap_contract.py ...`
Validation: `repository.root must be absolute`; `authorized_roots must be a nonempty array`; each `authorized_roots[i] must be absolute`

Validation of sources: nonempty array; each needs `path`, `kind`, lowercase 64-hex `sha256`, optional lowercase 64-hex `semantic_sha256`; duplicate paths refused; path must be inside `authorized_roots`
A source under a Specstride `learning/` state directory is refused (`... is Specstride learning state: learning/phase-<N>.json is rewritten at every approved phase ... (exit 23)`)
Validation: `validated contract needs stages`; duplicate stage ids refused; `kind is invalid`; `depends_on must be a string array`; `cwd is required` and must be inside `authorized_roots`
Every stage needs non-empty `postconditions` (`must support resume revalidation`) and an `evidence` string array inside authorized roots
Recovery validation: `max_attempts` positive; when >1 `retry_exit_codes` must be a nonempty int array, `backoff_seconds` nonnegative numbers, `total_timeout_seconds` positive
A `specstride` stage that retries exit code 4 must declare a `recovery.reason` constraint (`needs a reason constraint for Specstride exit 4`)

`recovery.reason` needs `jsonl` (inside authorized roots), optional `field` (default `reason`), optional `event`, and nonempty string array `allowed`; for a `specstride` stage every allowed value must be in `RETRYABLE_STOP_REASONS`
Dependencies must name known stages that appear earlier in the list (`unknown dependency`, `dependency must appear earlier`)
Strict validation rejects coverage entries that remain `unresolved` or `unsupported`
Strict validation rejects `producer` still `unclassified`, and a `stage:<id>` producer naming no stage
Strict validation rejects an `implementation` obligation with disposition `mapped` whose `stage_ids` include no `specstride` stage
Coverage entry shape: `id` unique, `source{path,line>0,anchor}` with path in sources, `stage_ids` known, `verification_ids` array, non-empty `rationale`, `evidence` array
Finding shape: unique `id`, `severity` in `info warning blocker`, `status` in `open resolved accepted`, non-empty `message`, string `resolution`
Strict validation rejects any open blocker: error text `findings[i] is an open blocker: <message>` (the supervisor gate matches the substring `open blocker`)
Validation order: structural errors are raised first (exit 20); source staleness and the learning binding are checked only when no structural error exists
Canonical contract bytes: `json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False)` + newline

Bundle `<artifact root>/generated/<id>/<first 20 hex of SHA-256 of canonical contract bytes>/` containing `launch-contract.json`, `runtime.py`, `contract_lib.py`; built in `.publish-*` temp dir, files fsynced, then `os.replace`
Launcher file written atomically with mode 0755; parent directory created

`rendered <output>` then `bundle <bundle>` on stdout, exit 0

Hidden runtime arguments `--contract` and `--launch-dir` (both required, supplied by the launcher)
Launcher `--implement`: run declared setup stages

`SPECSTRIDE_LEARNING` and `WIGGUM_LEARNING` are removed from every child environment (stages and `command_success` checks); `specstride` stages then get `SPECSTRIDE_LEARNING=off` unless the action env declares a value

Launcher exit 23 (`E_STALE`): stale sources or changed learning decisions at start
Launcher exit 20 (`E_INVALID`): contract invalid at start
Launcher exit 24 (`E_LOCK`): run directory lock held
Launcher exit 128+N: SIGINT, SIGTERM or SIGHUP received; the signal is forwarded to the child process group
Launcher exit 21 (`E_PREFLIGHT`): any preflight failure
Launcher exit 22 (`E_STAGE`): a stage failed and no signal was received (including child exit 6, which is state `stopped` but still launcher exit 22)
Launcher exit 0: all stages complete, or dry run
Stage reason `timeout` with child code 124 (action exceeded `timeout_seconds`, default 3600; SIGTERM to the group, SIGKILL after 5 s)
Stage reason `exit` (child exited non-zero and no retry applies)
Stage reason `exec-error:<exc>` with child code 127 (action could not be started)
Stage reason `existing-prerequisite` (setup stage satisfied without `--implement`; counts as success, child exit null)
Stage reason `setup-required`
Stage reason `stage-precondition`
Stage reason `interrupted` (child code 128+signal)
Stage reason `completed`
Stage reason `postcondition` (child exit 0, postcondition failed; never retried)
Stage reason `recovery-deadline` (elapsed >= `total_timeout_seconds`)
Stage reason `recovery-exhausted` is declared but unreachable (the loop always returns inside)
state.json `state` values: `preflight`, `ready`, `running`, `failed`, `stopped`, `completed`
state.json `exit_reason` `preflight`
state.json `exit_reason` `all-stages-complete`
`runs/<id>/state.json`: atomic (temp + fsync + os.replace), `indent=2, sort_keys=True`; an unreadable state is treated as empty
`runs/<id>/launcher.log`: opened in append mode; receives every labelled line and, for `specstride` stages with color off, the child's output with ANSI sequences stripped
`runs/<id>/lock`: `fcntl.flock(LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB)`, held for the process lifetime; the file is never removed
Color: only the `[LABEL]` is wrapped in ANSI codes (cyan/green/yellow/red/magenta/dim per label); launcher.log always receives the plain line
`[READY] <stage> already satisfies setup postconditions`
`[BLOCKED] <stage>: <failure>; rerun with --implement` (setup stage without `--implement`)
`[BLOCKED] <stage>: <failure>` (stage-timed precondition failed)
`[RUN] <stage> attempt <n>/<max>: <redacted action>`
`[PASS] <stage> completed`
`[ERROR] <stage> postcondition: <failure>` (child exit 0 but a postcondition failed)
`[RECOVER] <stage> exit <code>[, reason=<reason>]; retry in <delay>s`
`[FAIL] <stage> exit <code> (<outcome>)`
`[DRY-RUN] contract <id> is source-current; no actions or writes will occur`

`[PREFLIGHT] <stage>: <check detail>: pass|fail|deferred` for each preflight-timed precondition in a dry run (`command_success` is not executed and reads `deferred`); smoke stages skipped without `--smoke`
`[SKIP] <stage> (enable with --smoke)` in a dry run
`[CHECK] <stage> uses existing prerequisite; --implement would run setup` in a dry run
`[PLAN] <stage>: <redacted action>` in a dry run
`[DIGEST] state=dry-run exit=0 last-stage=none evidence=none` ends a dry run (stdout)
`[WARN] <warning>` on stderr at start for each validation warning (never colored, not logged)
`[STALE] <detail>` on stderr followed by `[DIGEST] state=failed exit=23 last-stage=none evidence=none` on stderr; nothing written to launcher.log
`[INVALID] <detail>` on stderr followed by `[DIGEST] state=failed exit=20 last-stage=none evidence=none` on stderr; nothing written to launcher.log
`[BLOCKED] another launcher owns <run dir>` then `[DIGEST] state=failed exit=24 last-stage=none evidence=<run dir>`
`[BLOCKED] <failure>` per preflight failure then `[DIGEST] state=failed exit=21 last-stage=none evidence=<run dir>`
`[SKIP] <stage> smoke stage disabled` in a live run
`[RESUME] <stage> postconditions still hold; skipping` and `[RESUME] <stage> postconditions changed; rerunning`

Failure/stop digest: `[DIGEST] state=<failed|stopped> exit=<launcher code> last-stage=<id> child-exit=<code|None> evidence=<run dir>`; `child-exit` prints the Python literal `None` when the stage never ran its action
Success digest: `[DIGEST] state=completed exit=0 last-stage=<last stage id in the contract, even when skipped> evidence=<run dir>` (no `child-exit`)
Argv redaction: argv items JSON-quoted and space-joined; when the action has env, prefixed `env[<sorted names>] ` (values never printed)
Condition paths beginning with `.specstride` or `.wiggum` are rewritten to the state directory name actually in use under the stage cwd

Check semantics: `file_exists` = is_file, `dir_exists` = is_dir, `env_set` = non-empty in the launcher's own environment, `command_available` = on PATH, `json_field_equals` = dotted field equality, `command_success` = exit 0 within `timeout_seconds` (default 60); unknown type fails as `unsupported check`
Reason lookup reads the JSONL from the offset (from 0 when the file shrank), filters by optional `event`, reads dotted `field` (default `reason`), keeps the LAST string value
With color off every child gets `NO_COLOR=1` (unless declared); a `specstride` stage also has `--live` removed, `--no-live` appended, `SPECSTRIDE_LIVE=false` and `WIGGUM_LIVE=false` set

Child I/O: a `specstride` stage runs on a pty when color is on and stdout is not a tty; with color off its merged output is piped, echoed and logged; other stage kinds inherit the launcher's streams and are not logged
Every child runs with stdin `/dev/null` in a new session (own process group)

Retry rule: child code in `retry_exit_codes`, and when `recovery.reason` is declared the newest matching reason in the JSONL (read from the byte offset recorded before the attempt) must be in `allowed`
From the second attempt the stage's `resume` action replaces `action` when declared
Backoff delay is `backoff_seconds[min(attempt-1, len-1)]`, 0 when none declared

Semantic contract digest drops `inventory`, `generated_by`, `repository.revision`, `repository.dirty`, replaces a tasks source `sha256` by its `semantic_sha256`, then SHA-256 of compact sorted JSON (no trailing newline)
Resume binding: state is reset (`stages: {}`, `superseded_contract_digest` recorded) when the semantic contract digest differs
state.json top-level fields: `pipeline contract_digest state updated_at stages last_stage exit_reason superseded_contract_digest`; timestamps are whole epoch seconds

Preflight covers, for every enabled stage: required `from_env` variables of `action` and `resume` (skipped for setup stages without `--implement`), preflight-timed preconditions, and setup postconditions when `--implement` is absent; all failures are collected before exiting
Terminal state is `stopped` when a signal was received or the child exited 6 (Specstride's stop code); otherwise `failed`
Per-stage state fields: `status` (`running completed failed stopped`), `started_at`, `finished_at`, `child_exit_code`, `reason`, and on completion `evidence`

Skill rule: before writing any artifact the host appends six ignore rules for `.mixture-of-loops/` to `.gitignore` (or `.git/info/exclude`), idempotently, and says which file received them
Skill rule: Specstride's verification plan is written to `.mixture-of-loops/<feature>/verification-commands.json` and passed with `--verification-commands`

Skill rule: a request that does not ask for execution gets `generate` (Silence is not consent to execute) and the closing message offers `run`
Skill rule: the host never edits a launcher, never passes `--replace-edited`, never runs `specstride learn --apply|--revert|--off`, never writes `status` itself
Skill rule: in `generate` the work ends after `bash -n` and `--dry-run`; a `fail` in `[PREFLIGHT]` is not a generation failure

`supervise.py learning --request TEXT [--token TOK ...]` prints `[MOL-LEARNING]`, plus a `[MOL-NEXT]` bootstrap hint when the mode is `apply`; always exit 0

`observe --json` additionally prints the raw observation as sorted JSON on stdout (not mirrored to the report log)
`--launcher` and `--run-dir` are mutually exclusive and one is required; `gate`, `launch` and `auto` accept only `--launcher`

`runs/<id>/harness-run.json` (schema `mixture-of-loops/harness-run/1`), atomic; fields `schema pipeline mode launcher argv cwd contract bundle cmdline_markers contract_digest flags pid pgid launched_at first_launched_at launcher_log_offset run_dir state_path launcher_log launch_log report_log stage_count relaunch_budget relaunches supervision` (+ `stop_requested`)

`runs/<id>/retrospectives/<semantic contract digest>.json` (schema `mol.retrospective/1`), atomic; fields `schema pipeline contract_digest generated_at stages`

`[MOL-LEARNING] mode=<off|suggest|apply> source=<...> evidence=<json string>`
`[MOL-LAUNCHER] launcher=<path> source=<request|feature-default|generated-marker>`

`[MOL-GATE] decision=<launch|refuse|attach>[ reason=<r>][ detail=<json>][ next=<json>]`
`[MOL-LAUNCH] pipeline= mode= launcher= run-dir= stages= flags=<json> relaunch-budget=<remaining>/<max> (<source>) wall-clock-ceiling=<g>s pid= stop="kill -TERM -<pgid>"`

`[MOL-HOLD] pipeline= unchanged=<count> stage=<i>/<n> id= state= total-elapsed=` printed for each unchanged observation
`[MOL-DIGEST] pipeline= state= exit=<int|unknown> child-exit=<int|none> last-stage=<id|none> evidence=<path> state-path=<path> next=<json>`

`[MOL-RELAUNCH] pipeline= attempt=<n>/<max> reason= exit= child-exit= stage= stop-reason=<python repr> budget-remaining= detail=<json>`; `stop-reason` is a Python repr (single quotes, or `None`), not JSON
`[MOL-REFUSE] action=<a> reason=<r> detail=<json>[ next=<json>]`
`[MOL-ANOMALY] pipeline= detail=<json>` per anomaly; for `unknown-terminal` also `[MOL-ANOMALY] pipeline= launch-log=<json of last 600 chars>`
Labelled lines are recognised by `^\[([A-Z][A-Z-]*)\] (.*)$`

`[DIGEST]` is parsed with `^\[DIGEST\] state=(\S+) exit=(-?\d+) last-stage=(\S+)(?: child-exit=(\S+))? evidence=(.*)$`; `child-exit=None` reads as null; the newest DIGEST in launcher.log wins, else the newest in the launch-log tail
Mode tokens `--auto`, `--run`, `--generate` (from `--token` or found in the request text by `(?<!\S)--[a-z-]+`) win over all prose; the first matching token in order decides

Refusal phrases (10 regexes: `don't|do not run/execute/launch/start`, `without running...`, `no execution`, `don't auto`, `just|only derive/generate/...`, `... only`, `generation only`, `dry-run only`, `no auto`) yield `generate` with source `refusal`
Auto phrases (`auto`, `auto-mode`, `<generation verb> ... and (then) run|execute`, `... then run|launch|execute`) yield `auto` with source `prose`

Run phrases (`run it|this|that|them`, `run the pipeline|launcher|run script|script|loop|stage(s)`, `execute|launch|start|kick off it/this/that/the X`, `resume the run|pipeline`, `for real`, `then run`, `and run it`) yield `run`, or `auto` when a generation word is also present
`implement`/`smoke` flags are read from tokens `--implement`/`--smoke` or phrases `with --implement`, `implement setup`, `with --smoke`, `smoke stage(s)`
A bare `dry-run`/`dry run` mention without an auto phrase yields `generate` with source `refusal` evidence `dry-run`
Default mode is `generate` with source `default` and empty evidence
Learning tokens `--learning-off|--learning-suggest|--learning-apply` win; then refusal phrases -> `off`; then apply phrases -> `apply`; then suggest phrases -> `suggest`; default `off`

Launcher resolution order: requested path (relative to repo) -> `<repo>/.mixture-of-loops/<slug>/run-<slug>.sh` -> the single file in the repo whose first 400 bytes contain `# mixture-of-loops-generated:` (skipping `.git`, symlinks, `.mixture-of-loops/generated` and `.mixture-of-loops/runs`)
`run-directory-free` probes by taking and releasing a non-blocking flock on `runs/<id>/lock`; a missing or unopenable lock file counts as free

Gate checks in fixed order: `launcher-intact`, `contract-validated`, `authorized-root`, `launcher-syntax`, `launcher-dry-run`, `run-directory-free`; first failure decides, later checks reported `not-evaluated`
The gate's dry run passes `--implement`/`--smoke` through and sets `NO_COLOR=1`, `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`, stdin closed, new session, cwd = launcher directory
Launch argv is `[<launcher>, --no-color][, --implement][, --smoke]`, never a shell string
Detached launch: stdin `/dev/null`, stdout+stderr appended to `harness-launch.log`, `start_new_session=True`, cwd = launcher directory

`auto` mode and `run` mode are recorded in `harness-run.json` and `[MOL-LAUNCH]` only; no code path in the supervisor branches on the mode value, so supervision and relaunch behave identically in both
`relaunch_budget` fields: `max_relaunches remaining wall_clock_seconds deadline declared_pipeline_seconds source`; the deadline is fixed at first launch and not extended by relaunches

Relaunch re-invokes the recorded argv in the recorded cwd with the supervisor's CURRENT environment (not the launch environment), decrements `remaining`, appends `{reason detail launcher_exit child_exit stage stage_reason stop_reason at pid remaining}` to `relaunches`, resets supervision
Stop: writes `stop_requested {signal, at}` to `harness-run.json` BEFORE signalling, sends SIGTERM to the recorded process group; no SIGKILL escalation

PID liveness: own child handle first; else `kill(pid, 0)` (PermissionError counts as alive); where `/proc/<pid>/cmdline` exists one recorded marker (launcher path or bundle dir name) must appear; without `/proc` (macOS) a reused PID reads as alive
Change signature = (status, run_state, stage_id, stage_index, stage_reason, detail, launcher_exit); clocks excluded

Observation authority order: `state.json`, then PID liveness, then labelled lines of `launcher.log` from the offset recorded at launch, then Specstride's newest stop reason, then the last 2000 bytes of `harness-launch.log`

Status derivation: alive -> `running` when state is `ready|running` else `starting`; not alive and launcher exit 24 -> `lock-conflict`; state `completed|failed|stopped` -> that; else from launcher exit (0 completed, >=128 stopped, other failed); else `unknown-terminal`
Stage elapsed is clamped to [0, total elapsed]; total elapsed counts from `first_launched_at`
Observation `detail` is the newest `RECOVER|BLOCKED|RESUME|ERROR|FAIL` labelled line as `<LABEL>: <message>`
The supervisor reads Specstride's newest stop reason from the stage's `recovery.reason.jsonl` from offset 0 (whole file), unlike the runtime which reads from the pre-attempt offset
Classifier conditions are evaluated in a fixed order, so the FIRST failing condition names the refusal; the order is part of the observable output
Digest `next` text: `relaunch: <detail>` when relaunching; `no relaunch (<reason>): <detail>` for a failed run; otherwise the fixed `NEXT_ACTION` text per status
Poll interval: returns to base on a change or when detail starts with `RECOVER`; otherwise previous x 1.5 capped at the max
Supervision state (`interval unchanged signature`) is persisted in `harness-run.json` after every non-terminal reading and cleared at terminal, so `observe` wake-ups agree with a continuous `watch`

Supervision expiry: when now + next interval would pass the deadline, prints `[MOL-REFUSE] action=supervise reason=supervision-expired` and a `[MOL-DIGEST]`, leaves the run running, status `supervision-expired` (exit 5)
Retro suggestions are derived by matching `[<id>]: regressed` in `learn --evaluate` output and rendered as `<argv0> learn -w <workdir> --feature <slug> --revert <id>`
Retro locates the feature from the first of `recovery.reason.jsonl`, `evidence[0]`, or a postcondition path matching `(.specstride|.wiggum)/features/<slug>`

Retro per `specstride` stage runs `<argv0> learn -w <workdir> --feature <slug> --summarize|--evaluate` (after probing each with `--help`), 120 s timeout, learning env stripped; any failure yields status `unavailable` with a reason
`run_stop reason=proposer_cap_exhausted` written on the structured path of the pass loop, with fields `iter`, `kill_reason`, `consec`; followed by exit 10.
`run_stop reason=proposer_consecutive_errors` written on the structured path of the pass loop, with fields `iter`, `subtype`, `kill_reason`, `kill_class`; followed by exit 7.
